descriptionText:
2024 Topps Composite football lot of 3 quarterbacks, all with the Topps Chrome front design.

Joe Montana - San Francisco - #16
Terry Bradshaw - Pittsburgh - #33
Drew Bledsoe - New England - #22

Three Super Bowl-winning and franchise quarterbacks in one lot. Ungraded, near mint or better. Every card is pictured front and back.

You will receive the exact three cards pictured. Shipped in sleeves and a toploader, protected.
